mapper.select: SELECT F.FUNDACCT fundacco, C.CUSTNO custno, C.INVNM invnm, C.INVTP invtp, C.IDTP idtp, C.IDNO idno, TE.BROKERNAME brokername, TE.BROKERIDTP brokeridtp, TE.BROKERIDNO brokeridno FROM TRADEACCOINFO T, TRADEACCOINFOEX TE, CUSTINFO C, FUNDACCOINFO F WHERE C.CUSTNO = F.CUSTNO AND TE.TRADEACCO = T.TRADEACCO AND T.CUSTNO = F.CUSTNO AND F.FUNDACCT = #{custNo}

SELECT SUM(DECODE(F.CHKFLAG, 'N', 1, 0)) ncount, SUM(DECODE(F.CHKFLAG || F.APPLYST, 'YN', 1, 0) + DECODE(F.CHKFLAG || F.APPLYST, 'YK', 1, 0)) ycount, SUM(DECODE(F.CHKFLAG, 'C', 1, 0)) fcount, SUM(DECODE(F.CHKFLAG, 'R', 1, 0)) ccount, SUM(DECODE(F.CHKFLAG || F.APPLYST, 'YC', 1, 0)) cancelcount FROM APPTRADEBLOTTER F, CUSTINFO C WHERE F.CUSTNO = C.CUSTNO AND F.ACCPTMD != '2' AND F.REGIONCODE = '0001' AND F.WORKDATE = (SELECT RTRIM(KYDATE) FROM SYSALTER WHERE KEY1 = 'EC' AND KEY2 = 'SYS' AND KEY3 = 'WORKDATE')
AND F.OPID != #{sp.batchoperatorId}

SELECT TO_CHAR(FT.AVIABLE,'FM9,999,999,999,999,990.00') aviable, TO_CHAR(FT.BALANCE,'FM9,999,999,999,999,990.00') balance, TO_CHAR(FT.ABNMFROZEN,'FM9,999,999,999,999,990.00') abnmfrozen, F.CUSTNO custno, F.FUNDACCT fundacco, F.TRADEACCO tradeacco, F.APKIND dsapkind, (SELECT PMNM FROM PARAMETER T1 WHERE T1.PMST = 'SYSTEM' AND T1.PMKY = 'APKIND' AND T1.PMV2 = 'T' AND T1.PMCO = F.APKIND) dsapkindnm, F.INVTP invtp, (SELECT PMNM FROM PARAMETER T1 WHERE T1.PMST = 'SYSTEM' AND T1.PMKY = 'INVTP' AND T1.PMCO = F.INVTP) invtpnm, C.INVNM invnm, F.BANKACCO bankacco, CHKFLAG chkflag, (SELECT PMNM FROM PARAMETER T1 WHERE T1.PMST = 'DS' AND T1.PMKY = 'CHKFLAG' AND T1.PMCO = CHKFLAG) chkflagnm, F.FUNDID fundid, (SELECT T.FUNDNM FROM FUNDINFO T WHERE T.FUNDID = F.FUNDID) fundnm, F.ACCPTMD trustType, (SELECT PMNM FROM PARAMETER T1 WHERE T1.PMST = 'SYSTEM' AND T1.PMKY = 'ACCPTMD' AND T1.PMCO = F.ACCPTMD) trustTypenm, TO_CHAR(F.SUBAMT,'FM9,999,999,999,999,990.00') subamt, TO_CHAR(F.SUBQUTY,'FM9,999,999,999,999,990.00') subquty, F.OPID operatorId, F.GRANTEEID checkno, F.APDT apdt, F.LARGEREDEEMFLAG largeflag, (SELECT PMNM FROM PARAMETER T1 WHERE T1.PMST = 'SYSTEM' AND T1.PMKY = 'LARGEREDEEMFLAG' AND T1.PMCO = F.LARGEREDEEMFLAG) largeflagnm, F.OFUNDACCT ofundacco, F.OTRADEACCO otradeacco, F.OSEATNO oseatno, (SELECT SEATNM FROM SEAT S WHERE S.SEATNO = F.OSEATNO) oseatnm, F.ONETPOINT onetpoint, F.SERIALNO serialno, F.OLDAPPNO oldserialno, F.NETPOINT netpoint, (SELECT SEATNM FROM SEAT S WHERE S.SEATNO = F.NETPOINT) netpointnm, F.SUMMARY remark, F.OFUNDID ofundid, (SELECT T.FUNDNM FROM FUNDINFO T WHERE T.FUNDID = F.OFUNDID) ofundnm, F.MELONMD melonmd, (SELECT PMNM FROM PARAMETER T1 WHERE T1.PMST = 'SYSTEM' AND T1.PMKY = 'INVTP' AND T1.PMCO = F.MELONMD) melonmdnm, TO_CHAR(F.DIVIDENDRATE,'FM9,999,999,999,999,990.00') melonpercent, F.CHECKER checker, F.BROKER broker FROM APPTRADEBLOTTER F, CUSTINFO C, (SELECT FB.TRADEACCO AS TRADEACCO, FB.FUNDID AS FUNDID, FB.BALANCE, NVL(TQ.CHANGEQUTY, 0) + FB.ABNMFROZEN AS ABNMFROZEN, FB.BALANCE - FB.ABNMFROZEN - NVL(TQ.CHANGEQUTY, 0) AS AVIABLE FROM (SELECT t.TRADEACCO AS TRADEACCO, T.FUNDID AS FUNDID, NVL(SUM(CHANGEQUTY), 0) AS CHANGEQUTY FROM TRADEREQUEST_QTRACE T GROUP BY T.TRADEACCO, T.FUNDID) TQ, FUNDBALANCE FB WHERE FB.TRADEACCO = TQ.TRADEACCO(+) AND FB.FUNDID = TQ.FUNDID(+)) FT WHERE C.CUSTNO = F.CUSTNO AND F.SERIALNO = #{serialno} AND F.TRADEACCO = FT.TRADEACCO(+) AND F.FUNDID = FT.FUNDID(+)
